messages.text: No, it wouldn't be my first. I've been in and out of mining since 2013. I'm just looking to see what kind of miners are available now. The 40T is looking pretty cool.

Good pick to be looking at. The 40T is $799 for a BM1370 tower, 40 TH/s at ~650W, tunable 30 to 50 TH/s, about 50 dB in Eco. Best price per terahash we sell. Current batch ships Nov 14, 2026.

Since 2013 you've seen the noise problem — what are you paying for power these days?

At 12 cents, the 40T at 40 TH/s pulls about 468 kWh a month, so roughly $56 in power. That's the honest cost side; the draw is a full block ticket every ten minutes, round the clock, plus sats stacking to your own wallet in between, and you still own the machine.

You planning to run it solo, or point it at a pool?
Most likely solo, either BTC or BCH.

Solo is the 40T's default — it ships pointed at your own node and address, so that's the box for you. 40 TH/s is a real solo ticket at $799.

BTC is what it's set up for out of the box. BCH is the same SHA-256, but I don't want to promise a config I haven't confirmed — want me to have the team confirm BCH solo before you commit?
Handed to the team · BCH solo support on the Magic Miner 40T not confirmed in product facts

The team has it — someone will jump in here with the BCH answer, or email you if you step away.

Meanwhile, the 40T at $799 ships Nov 14, 2026, and the current batch is 50 units. Want me to have a cart ready so you're not fighting the drop later?
Do you have any promo codes?
None I can give — the price on the page is the price, $799. I've passed the ask to Georges with the BCH question, and he'll answer both right here.
Before you go, one thing: after coming back to mining, what made you land on the 40T rather than something bigger?
I want something that I can use with a 110v plug.

That works — the 40T's PSU is 100-240V, IEC C14, so a standard 110V wall outlet is fine. At 650W it's about 6 amps, well inside a normal circuit even in Turbo.

Plug and cord are matched to your shipping address at checkout.
